jobs_results.title: Senior Back-End Engineer (Node.js/TypeScript)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel and our family of growing companies are made up of global teams dedicated to helping businesses hire anyone, anywhere, easily.

The team comprises over three thousand self-driven individuals spanning over 100 countries, and our unified yet diverse culture keeps us continually learning and innovating the platform and products for customers.

Companies should be able to hire the best talent anywhere in the world, so we are building the best platform to make that a reality. Our market-leading technology, expertise, and global team are crucial to the platform’s success. We deliver the best products and features in our space, enabling millions of jobs worldwide and connecting the global workforce with the best companies and opportunities.

Why should you be part of our success story?

A 30-mile hiring radius should no longer dictate how companies hire because exceptional talent lives everywhere. Deel sees a world without hiring borders and endless talent... that pairs perfect candidates with great companies.

We offer global teams all the tools they need to hire, onboard, manage, pay, and scale at full speed. We aim to foster a diverse global economy by building a generational platform that seamlessly connects companies with talent worldwide.

After our successful Series D in 2021, we raised another $50M in 2023, doubling our valuation to $12B. There’s never been a more exciting time to join Deel — the international payroll and compliance market leader.

Get ready to:
• Be a part of a truly cross-functional team; Frontend Engineers, Product Teams, Designers and QA’s
• Participate in product planning (From discovery all the way to deployment); We want your input at all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle!
• Collaborate! Our teams work together to develop robust new features, API’s, continuously improve our industry-leading products and find and fix any bugs at Deel Speed
• Ensure our customers receive a white-glove experience with our products!

The bits and bytes that you’ll bring to your new team:
• You have expert knowledge of Node.js and at least one other server side language.
• You’re an expert in JavaScript/TypeScript syntax
• You’re a database guru! You know the ins and outs of SQL and NoSQL, mainly PostgreSQL and ORM libraries (such as Sequelize)
• You have a good understanding of AWS Services such as S3, EKS, SNS and SQS
• You have experience with serverless app architecture on AWS
• You have at least 8 years of experience as a Software Engineer
• You are able to advise on best practices and be a thought leader in your field

You're the Engineer we're looking for if you:
• Excel in the art of designing, coding, testing, and maintaining applications using the tech listed above
• Thrive in a collaborative, remote-first work culture where teamwork, camaraderie, and being Together Everywhere are key
• Embrace independence and take ownership of your projects, yet also excel in a team setting and love to contribute
• Communicate complex ideas with ease and enjoy collaborating with diverse teams of technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Are passionate about solving customer problems with your coding superpowers, and approach challenges with Default Optimism whilst maintaining a balanced perspective in all aspects of your work
• Take a business-focused approach to software development, with a keen eye on delivering high-value outcomes for our clients
• Embody our core value of Genuine Care, deeply understanding and addressing the impact of your work on our customers

Extra brownie points if you:
• Have experience with SaaS products running 24/7 on a major cloud vendor
• Have honed your skills working in distributed teams and thrive in a remote work environment
• Have knowledge of the dynamic world of FinTech

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Some things you’ll enjoy
• Provided computer equipment tailored to your role
• Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
• The flexibility of remote work, including WeWork access where available

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page

jobs_results.title: Ruby - Elixir Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres aprender a desarrollar en Elixir?

Desde e-Frontiers estamos buscando profesionales con perfil fullstack o backend con experiencia en RoR o Erlang...en desarrollo web y/o de software, y que quieran familiarizarse y trabajar con Elixir. Estamos ayudando a una empresa tecnológica de producto propio cuya herramienta ayuda al crecimiento de empresas, webs y comercios electrónicos (contratación directa con cliente final).

Funciones:
• Trabajarás en el equipo de desarrollo, principalmente donde además aprenderás a desarrollar con Elixir y utilizar otras tecnologías como AWS y Phoenix .
• Muchos de sus servicios están basados en Python o RoR, por lo que si tienes experiencia con alguno de estos lenguajes será un plus.
• Contribuir al desarrollo del sistema ayudando en su diseño e implementación.
• Garantizar el trabajo en equipo.

Requisitos:
• Al menos 4 años de experiencia en backend con alguno de estos lenguajes: RoR, Erlang, Go...
• Interés y motivación por aprender Elixir.
•... Experiencia en front: JS, HTML, CSS...
• Nivel de inglés medio: suficiente para entender documentación técnica y poder intercambiar emails.

Valorable:
• Muy valorable experiencia previa en Python, Elixir, Erlang, Phoenix, RoR...
• Muy valorable experiencia con AWS.
• Experiencia en proyectos basados en microservicios.
• Experiencia en UX sería un plus.

Condiciones:
• Contrato indefinido y directo con cliente final.
• Seguro de salud.
• Modelo de trabajo remoto o híbrido en base a tus necesidades.
• Horario flexible.
• Actividades de formación para equipos.
• Salario: 35.000€ - 55.000 € en base a años de experiencia (aunque la franja es negociable).

¿Quieres saber un poco más? Inscríbete y te llamaremos para entrar en detalles

jobs_results.title: Backend Software Developer (m/w) - Ref. 240401
jobs_results.description:
MAIN PURPOSE

We are looking for a talented Backend Software Developer to work for one of our clients, a major international sport organization. You will reinforce the Digital Legal team in charge of the conception, implementation, and support of the new Digital Legal systems in our client (including three Web portals, a case management Back-Office and their integrations).

You will participate in all the stages in the life cycle of those systems, following Agile methodologies and good practices in design, documentation, programming, and security. A good attitude towards learning different technologies is a required as the position will comprehend mainly back-end related duties but also some DevOps ones.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Communicate in fluent spoken and written English with technical and non-technical users at all levels of the organization.

· Collaborate with other Architecture, Development, and DevOps teams in delivering a high-quality product.

· Design the new features of... the Digital Legal systems and make architectural decisions with the agreement of the Product Owner.

· Coding in different languages and frameworks: Java / J2EE, Spring, Javascript, SQL.

· Develop the new functionality requested by the client and maintain the currently existing one.

· Enrich the DevOps platform to automate and control the SW delivery process.

· Produce and review technical documentation for the before mentioned elements.

· Be responsible for the quality of your own work and the rest of the development team.

REQUIREMENTS

· Senior IT professional with proven experience (3+ years) eager to learn.

· Hold a B.Sc. or MSc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

· Ability to communicate with technical and business teams (all levels) in fluent English.

· Solid technical background and architectural skills.

· Hands-on experience with software development, especially in back end.

· Mastering the REST API architectural principles.

· Knowledge building containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) to be run on an AWS cloud platform.

· Understanding AngularJS or other similar front-end technologies is a plus.

· Familiarity with the software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.

· Live and have a valid work permit in the Spanish territory already.

Other desired skills:

· Technologies: Java / J2EE, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs.

· Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, EKS.

· DevOps: Jenkins, Git

· Cloud: AWS.

· Databases: MySQL.

· Issue Tracker: JIRA.

· Agile Methodologies: Scrum, Kanban.

WHAT WE OFFER

· Competitive salary

· Monthly communication allowance

· 5 weeks of vacation / year

· Private health insurance paid by the company

· Work in an international environment with highly qualified professionals

· Access to modern and diverse technologies combined with trendy methodologies

· Continuous training and professional development

As an IT professional, we understand if you don't master all the previously mentioned technologies and skills; we'll take care of training and offer you the necessary time and courses to do it.

LOCATION

· Fully remote work but based in Spain, ideally in the Principality of Asturias or the Community of Madrid.

INTERESTED?

Please send your resume and motivation letter to jobs[at]digiswit.com or reply to this offer

jobs_results.title: Lead Backend Programmer
jobs_results.description:
Anchor Point Studios is a NetEase Games global game studio fuelled by a world-class team of developers. With a passion for creating immersive and engaging console and PC action games, Anchor Point seeks to push the boundaries of entertainment in extraordinary ways and develop experiences that are both memorable and timeless.

Based in Barcelona & Seattle, Anchor Point Studios is hiring developers, artists, designers and more for office, hybrid, and remote roles.

Lead Backend Programmer

Anchor Point Studios

Barcelona based studio, full-remote options

AAA

Founded by veteran game designer Paul Ehreth in October of 2022, Anchor Point Studios is a NetEase Games global game studio fueled by a world-class team of developers. With a passion for creating immersive and engaging console and PC action games, Anchor Point Studios seeks to push the boundaries of entertainment in extraordinary ways and develop experiences that are both memorable and timeless.

We are Anchor Point Studios and... we’re looking for a Lead Backend Programmer to help us build the future of mind-blowing video game entertainment for a new, innovative 3D action title.

About The Role

We are Anchor Point Studios and we’re looking for a Lead Backend Programmer to help us build the future of mind-blowing video game entertainment for a new, innovative 3D action title.

Responsibilities

As our Lead Backend Programmer, you will be responsible for the design and development of our robust backend systems while collaborating with our external partners. Additionally:
• Work closely with game designers to ensure backend systems support and enhance game features and player experiences include authentication, player data management, and battle pass systems.
• Work with our technology partners to integrate advanced backend technologies and tools, fostering innovation and expanding the capabilities of our games.
• Lead the design and development of robust backend systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and security to support game functionalities and user data management.
• Develop and maintain Unreal Engine C++ client code for interacting with backend services, facilitating seamless gameplay experiences and data exchange.
• Oversee the deployment and management of backend services on cloud platforms, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and scalability.
• Implement and maintain security measures to protect user data and comply with relevant laws and regulations, conducting regular security audits and updates.
• Team Leadership and Mentorship: Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to backend development teams, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and quality delivery.
• Integration with BaaS Platforms: Evaluate, select, and integrate appropriate Backend as a Service platforms to expedite development while meeting project requirements and timelines.

About You
• Demonstrable experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining backend systems from scratch, with a strong understanding of backend architecture best practices.
• Familiarity with leading BaaS software (e.g., PlayFab, Gamesparks, Accelbyte, etc.), including integration, customization, and optimization to meet project needs.
• Experience in developing client-side Unreal Engine C++ code for consuming backend services, ensuring seamless integration and communication between the game and backend systems.
• Advanced proficiency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., C#, Python, Javascript, etc.) and familiarity with database management systems (SQL and NoSQL).
• Knowledge of networking protocols, security best practices for backend development, and experience in implementing secure, scalable, and high-performance services.
• Experience in designing, developing, and managing RESTful APIs and understanding of web services architecture.
• Experience with cloud computing services (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) for hosting and managing backend infrastructure, including knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

Why Anchor Point Studios?

We’re drawn to who you are, not just what you do. We’re humble, passionate and dedicated to the journey of creating something extraordinary. Something that will push the boundaries of entertainment in ways that will develop memorable and timeless experiences.

You can expect a well thought out benefits package that rewards and recognises your dedication to the role.

As a Netease Games studio, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and encourage applications from everyone. We are adventurous and open to challenge. We are humble and committed to lasting quality for our games.

We are seeking adventurous teammates who are ready to challenge themselves, are humble and eager to learn, and passionate about crafting exceptional experiences. Our studio's motto is Per Aspera, Ad Astra (through hardships, to the stars) which acknowledges that what we're setting out to do may be difficult, but if we work together, we will overcome these challenges and build something truly amazing together. We will be building action-adventure experiences that take risks and journey deep into uncharted territory. The best things in life are hard-earned, and this is a truth we confidently embrace as we set out to blaze a new trail in the gaming landscape

jobs_results.title: Junior Python Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Are you ready to take on the challenge of building the data supply chain? Our team creates cutting-edge software for data extraction, streaming, and exploitation that's used to transform their businesses.

We're looking for a talented and innovative technical professional to join our dynamic team. Our headquarters are based in the beautiful city of Málaga, and we have a brand co-working space in the heart of Santa Cruz de Tenerife to provide even more opportunities for local talent. Plus, we offer the flexibility of remote work options!

Take your career to the next level with our advanced solutions and passionate team!

What you will do
• Design, develop and support advanced software solutions for data streaming, analysis, visualization, and exploitation, for example our high-performance data platforms.
• Collaborate closely with your peers and our clients, to define, design, and ship new features.
• Optimize and refactor existing code for improved performance and... scalability.
• Write comprehensive tests to ensure the reliability and stability of backend services.
• Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and best practices in backend development.
• Document technical designs, processes, and procedures.

What you will bring
• Degree in Computer Sciences, Software Engineering, or similar education in software development.
• Proficiency in Python and experience (1/2 years) with backend frameworks such as FastAPI.
• High level of English and strong communication skills, in both speaking and writing.
• High understanding of Git version control and processes.
• Understanding of REST API architecture design principles.
• Proactive and troubleshooter mentality, attention to detail and precision.

What is a plus for us?
• Experience with AI frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, Keras or Tensorflow.
• Knowledge of Docker, and Kubernetes.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
• Knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, GitHub actions, and Argo CD.
• Experience with streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka).
• Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

What's in it for you?
• 💰Competitive Paycheck. Plus, Monthly home office allowance and Setup budget for your home office comfort!
• ✨ Dream Team ! Work alongside skilled and dynamic colleagues in a flexible environment.
• 🤝 Tackle challenging projects that directly influence our customers' and company's success.
• 🚀We value your happiness and growth! Regular assessments ensure you're challenged and constantly evolving.
• Stay sharp with FREE English classes and an annual Learning & Development budget.
• 🏥 Wellbeing First. Prioritize your health with complete private health insurance.
• ⚖️ Work-Life Balance . Achieve balance with our flexible work model and hybrid way of working.
• Celebrate in style with an extended birthday off to recharge and reconnect.
• 💼 Bond with colleagues at regular team events and celebrations!
• Tech-tastic Tools. Utilize cutting-edge equipment to stay ahead of the curve.
• ☀️ Work in a beautiful Málaga city-center office with free drinks, organic fruit 🍏, delicious snacks, and chill break spaces.

Become an Fmitter today!

At FMIT we have a friendly collaborative culture and a united team vision. All of our #Fmitters have the ability to make a big impact (we love high ambition mindsets). Our work is rewarding and we help each other win by creating a supportive and collaborative environment for one another. Take a look at our opening and send us your application - we look forward to hearing from you

• Collaborate closely with your peers and our clients, to define, design, and ship new features.
• Optimize and refactor existing code for improved performance and... scalability.
• Write comprehensive tests to ensure the reliability and stability of backend services.
• Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and best practices in backend development.
• Document technical designs, processes, and procedures.

What you will bring
• Degree in Computer Sciences, Software Engineering, or similar education in software development.
• Proficiency in Python and experience (1/2 years) with backend frameworks such as FastAPI.
• High level of English and strong communication skills, in both speaking and writing.
• High understanding of Git version control and processes.
• Understanding of REST API architecture design principles.
• Proactive and troubleshooter mentality, attention to detail and precision.

What is a plus for us?
• Experience with AI frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, Keras or Tensorflow.
• Knowledge of Docker, and Kubernetes.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
• Knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, GitHub actions, and Argo CD.
• Experience with streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka).
• Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

What's in it for you?
• 💰Competitive Paycheck. Plus, Monthly home office allowance and Setup budget for your home office comfort!
• ✨ Dream Team ! Work alongside skilled and dynamic colleagues in a flexible environment.
• 🤝 Tackle challenging projects that directly influence our customers' and company's success.
• 🚀We value your happiness and growth! Regular assessments ensure you're challenged and constantly evolving.
• Stay sharp with FREE English classes and an annual Learning & Development budget.
• 🏥 Wellbeing First. Prioritize your health with complete private health insurance.
• ⚖️ Work-Life Balance . Achieve balance with our flexible work model and hybrid way of working.
• Celebrate in style with an extended birthday off to recharge and reconnect.
• 💼 Bond with colleagues at regular team events and celebrations!
• Tech-tastic Tools. Utilize cutting-edge equipment to stay ahead of the curve.
• ☀️ Work in a beautiful Málaga city-center office with free drinks, organic fruit 🍏, delicious snacks, and chill break spaces.

Become an Fmitter today!

At FMIT we have a friendly collaborative culture and a united team vision. All of our #Fmitters have the ability to make a big impact (we love high ambition mindsets). Our work is rewarding and we help each other win by creating a supportive and collaborative environment for one another. Take a look at our opening and send us your application - we look forward to hearing from you

jobs_results.title: Backend Liferay Developer
jobs_results.description:
Así somos.

The Cocktail es una consultora tecnológica multinacional cuya misión es acelerar el crecimiento sostenible de nuestros clientes. Movilizamos grandes organizaciones para mejorar la relación entre las marcas y personas mediante el Diseño, los Datos y la Tecnología. Entendemos lo que nuestros clientes necesitan y orquestamos capacidades para lograr esos objetivos a una velocidad de vértigo. Nuestra cultura se basa en la diversidad, creatividad y en la mezcla de especialistas (estrategia, diseño, tecnología, data, investigación…) Nuestras carreras se caracterizan por un crecimiento profesional exponencial, y por la participación en proyectos con impacto real en grandes clientes. Formar parte de The Cocktail implica rodearse de un equipo inspirador del que aprender y que te ayudará a crecer. Trabajamos bajo la máxima de que es mejor pedir perdón que permiso, por eso, esperamos de ti una visión disruptiva y challenger, inconformismo y pasión por la excelencia y los desafíos.

Si... quieres moverte en un entorno retador, crear proyectos innovadores y hacer que las cosas pasen, The Cocktail es para ti.

Este es el reto.

Seguimos creciendo en el ámbito de plataformas y buscamos gente sin miedo a la velocidad, apasionada por implementar proyectos con soluciones DXP, que quiera liderar y extender el conocimiento relativo a Liferay en la parte de Back dentro de nuestros equipos de Tecnología. Todo ello en un entorno multidisciplinar, liderando el proceso de transformación digital de nuestros clientes junto con el resto de áreas de The Cocktail.

En tu día a día:
• Desarrollar e implementar proyectos con Liferay Portal (versiones 7.2 y 7.4)
• Participar en toda la vida del proyecto, desde el prototipado y análisis funcional hasta el análisis y liderazgo técnico.
• Implementación de portlets y Service Builders, como la gestión de contenidos y Microservicios
• Conocimientos en la gestión y adaptación del código fuente del CORE de Liferay para la realización de migraciones de datos
• Programación en Java siguiendo el modelo MVC portlet.
• Otros lenguajes; jquery, Hibernate, freemarker, Azure Devops/AWS, Github/Bitbucket, PostgresSQL/MySQL/Oracle
• Definir la mejor solución técnica junto al resto de equipos de Tecnología.
• Trabajar de forma conjunta con los equipos de UX, Diseño Estratégico, Negocio y Estrategia.
• Defender las fortalezas y aplicabilidad de la plataforma frente al resto de áreas y al cliente, tanto en español como en inglés.

Además, cuando lleves un tiempo aquí, esperamos que seas capaz de:
• Asegurar los planes y los procesos de calidad de un proyecto, desarrollando tests y llevando a cabo proceso s de CI/CD.
• Aprender otras tecnologías y lenguajes como Groovy y Kotlin.
• Trabajar con una filosofía 100% DevOps con herramientas como Jenkins, Docker y Kubernetes.
• Construir un entorno de reconocimiento y celebración. Apropiarte de la visión de la compañía y que la hagas propia.

¿Cómo es la experiencia en The Cocktail?
• Modelo de trabajo basado en la autorresponsabilidad y la autogestión con horario flexible y teletrabajo (de verdad). Decides tu horario, desde dónde trabajas y cómo lo haces.
• Buscamos la excelencia/mejora en lo que hacemos, generando un ambiente colaborativo. Nuestra filosofía es 70-20-10 (70% se aprende de la experiencia, 20% de mentores/referentes y 10% de formación reglada).
• Podrás disfrutar de 25 días de vacaciones al año repartidos entre verano y Navidad, sobre todo. También te regalamos Nochebuena y Nochevieja.
• Paquete de ventajas sociales y posibilidad de retribución flexible.
• No tenemos dress code. Ven como quieras a trabajar.
• Ser parte de una compañía con alma: tenemos iniciativas de apoyo a la maternidad (una sala de lactancia en la oficina y programas para mamás y papás), la sostenibilidad (políticas zero waste), la igualdad de género y diversidad (iniciativas de visibilización e inclusión del colectivo LGTB+, colaboraciones para disminuir la desigualdad social...).
• Descuentos y múltiples ventajas para tu ocio y día a día.

En The Cocktail pretendemos ser un referente en talento y calidad humana, y sólo lo conseguiremos siendo una compañía abierta y diversa, por eso tenemos un Código de Conducta que refleja nuestras expectativas de las personas que participan en la empresa. Ofrecemos un entorno acogedor para todos, independientemente de su identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, capacidad, origen, religión, estatus socioeconómico…

Próximos pasos:

Si has llegado hasta aquí es porque hemos conseguido llamar tu atención ;)

Apúntate a la oferta y el equipo de People echará un vistazo a tu CV. Si coincide con lo que buscamos, recibirás una llamada para conocernos mejor, que podamos contarte más sobre The Cocktail y el sobre el rol

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer (PHP)
jobs_results.description:
Job title: Senior Software Engineer

Location: Lahore, Madrid, Barcelona

About Gelato

Gelato has built the world's largest and most global platform for on-demand production and fulfillment of customized products. Today, those products are part of huge markets, such as apparel, wall-art, drinkware, digitally printed books, greeting cards. In the future, the market opportunities are endless thanks to new technologies such as 3D printing. We support a new wave of e-commerce entrepreneurs to sell their creativity globally, with a more local and sustainable production. With local production and exact matching of supply and demand, there is no waste, and carbon emissions are reduced. We support a new wave of e-commerce entrepreneurs and the global shift towards local and more sustainable production.

Gelato Technology

We own no physical production assets, nor servers, instead our asset is a cloud based connectivity platform that enables world-class on-demand production for e-commerce... platforms and applications. This engineered platform needs to provide our customers access to more than 130 production partners in 32 countries and includes production plate design, routing to an appropriate partner, finally linking to logistics’ systems for delivery to the consumer. All this in 72 hours and reaching more than 5 billion people and potential consumers in a smarter, faster, and greener way.

The employed technologies range from backends using PHP and GoLang to mobile apps built natively or with hybrid technology, running on cloud services and with a modern CI/CD pipeline. Designing highly-available, fault-tolerant, cost-effective, scalable systems is our passion. We are using TDD, BDD, DDD principles and patterns, and agile methodology. Designing public API for millions of people, integrating with world-class third-party systems, and solving complex engineering problems (Graph, CAP, etc) are only a small glimpse into the tasks.

What you will be doing
• Using the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
• Collaborating closely with other engineers as a valuable member of a cross-functional team
• Sharing your knowledge and building creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices
• Designing, developing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and scalability
• Taking end-to-end responsibility for the services that are owned by your team, including taking part in an on-call rotation

Who you are
• A programming language agnostic having 5+ years of experience in a similar role
• Having a minimum of B.S. degree in Information Technology or Computer Sciences
• Able to adapt, change and grow quickly as we scale the organization
• Passionate about engineering practices like agile, continuous delivery, test-driven development, traceability, and observability
• Growth mentality, are curious and not afraid to be experimental.
• You share your ideas and continuously improve yourself and the team around you
• Solid experience as an Engineer designing, developing, and maintaining API driven solutions
• Strong communication skills, high integrity, and great attention to detail

Possess knowledge and experience, or have an interest in working with:
• Docker and Kubernetes
• PHP (Symfony)
• Microservices architecture
• PostgreSQL, Elastic search, RabbitMQ
• Memcache, Redis
• ELK, Jaeger, Prometheus & Grafana

What we offer

We offer you a chance to be part of a truly amazing journey in a company that sets very high targets and works hard to achieve them. You will be able to work with smart, motivated, and engaged co-workers from all over the world, in an intense and very energetic environment. This leads to you having a tangible impact on the way that we operate and expand our business.

Some of the highlights of the package include:
• Strong technical culture of continuous innovation and improvement
• Chance to become a shareholder of Gelato!
• Flexible holidays, swap days off according to your values, beliefs and needs.
• Get paid in international currency
• And much much more!
• As we continue to grow we want you to grow with us and for the right candidate, there is no limit to where this opportunity might take you. Together we can increase global GDP by effectively supporting local sustainable on-demand production

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer​/Full Remote
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Full Remote )

Live Ticket Group is seeking a talented Senior Backend Software Engineer to join their team, driving innovation in the live event industry. Dedicated to revolutionizing the way fans access unforgettable moments in sports and entertainment, Live Ticket Group offers an exciting opportunity for those ready to propel their careers forward in a dynamic environment. If you're passionate about technology and ready to contribute to shaping the future of live events, Live Ticket Group is the perfect place for you.
WHAT

IS THEIR PURPOSE?

Live Ticket Group emerges as a leading force in the European live event marketplace, fostering connections between fans and unforgettable sports experiences. Their primary aim revolves around delivering unparalleled customer satisfaction within the secondary ticket market, revolutionizing how millions engage with live football and rugby events globally.

Functioning as a live entertainment platform... Live Ticket Group simplifies the ticket purchasing process for fans, ensuring a seamless journey from selection to stadium entry. Their ethos centers on facilitating experiences where fans can fully immerse themselves in the thrill of live events, eliminating any hassle along the way.

Enthusiasts at heart, the team at Live Ticket Group shares the same passion for live events as their customers. They understand the profound ability of live events to unite and create lasting memories, committing themselves to curating these extraordinary moments for fans worldwide, fostering connections through shared experiences.

At Live Ticket Group , they take pride in being the architects of their customers' most cherished moments, their ultimate live experiences.Their goal is to keep fans on the edge of their seats, yearning for more, from the moment they secure their ticket until the final whistle blows.
WHY FALL IN LOVE WITH THEM?

Ensuring that every step of the journey is nothing short of magical, Live Ticket Group prioritizes quality and integrity. Unlike many competitors, they focus on reputable sellers on their platform, earning consistently high ratings and glowing reviews, boasting an impressive 4.8 out of 5 in Trustpilot score. While their initial focus has been on sports events, Live Ticket Group is gradually expanding into new markets, seamlessly connecting buyers and sellers to facilitate transactions.

With a history spanning 16 years, Live Ticket Group has experienced steady, organic growth, always prioritizing profitability over rapid expansion. Now, at a pivotal moment in their journey, they're poised for both business and product expansion. They're reimagining their platform from the ground up, leveraging modern technology to deliver a refreshed user experience with enhanced features, setting the stage for an even more immersive and enjoyable experience for their users.

The story of Live Ticket Group is one of passion, dedication, and the relentless pursuit of excellence. Join them as they continue to redefine the live event experience, one unforgettable moment at a time.
WHAT WILL BE YOUR MISSION?

In response to the rapidly evolving technology landscape, Live Ticket Group is actively seeking Software Engineers to leverage cutting-edge innovations in designing and developing next-generation technologies and complex features.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer at Live Ticket Group , individuals will spearhead the resolution of significant, ambitious, and non-trivial challenges. They serve as core contributors and innovators, translating creative technical solutions into reality. Demonstrating initiative and enthusiasm for problem-solving is essential for success within the company.

Live Ticket Group remains dedicated to fostering an exceptional and inclusive work environment. The company brings together a diverse array of creative problem solvers and proactive individuals, all driven by a shared commitment to driving change – within the organization and for its valued customers

What you’ll do:

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain impactful improvements across all Live Ticket Group platforms and products, resulting in high-quality outcomes.

- Collaborate with team members to ensure best practices across their code.

- Manage individual initiative priorities, deadlines, and deliverables with your technical expertise.

- Mentor other team members and help many increase their technical capabilities, fostering a culture of inclusion, results-oriented execution, open innovation, and limitless creativity.
WHAT DO THEY NEED FROM YOU TO CONQUER THIS CHALLENGE?

What will make you succeed in this position of Senior Backend Software Engineer?

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development.
- Extensive experience developing robust, mission-critical systems using C# / .NET.
- Demonstrated expertise in building software with one or more of the following:
Infrastructure, Databases, Data Processing, Distributed Systems, Security, and Privacy.
- Previous experience designing and developing…

jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect is an established company with a start-up culture seeking creative entrepreneurial people like you to join our team. We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our global team to be responsible for the quality, development, and execution of our software products.

About TransPerfect:

TransPerfect helps organizations navigate the global marketplace. It remains founder-led – and has striven to maintain the ethos and drive that led them to grow organically year-on-year for the past 30 years. Starting in an NYU dorm room in the early 1990s, TransPerfect is now recognized as the largest translation and language services company in the world. From offices in more than 90 cities on six continents, TransPerfect offers a full range of services in 170+ languages to clients worldwide.

You will be part of a technology department that is comprised of a successful and multidisciplinary group of professionals located across the globe – Barcelona, New York, London, Manchester... Bucharest and India. If you’re ready to join a growing company and make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you!

About the team you will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.

To learn more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:
• Engage in all phases of application development, with a focus on coding and debugging in alignment with security standards throughout the entire lifecycle
• Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code/APIs to support applications both for web and mobile
• Collaborate regularly in a cross-functional team made up of product managers, quality assurance teams, designers and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
• Collaborate with Front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
• Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address issues
• Optimize web applications for performance, scalability and security
• Implement security best practices to safeguard sensitive data and protect against potential threats
• Develop automation tests/ collaborate with automation engineers to ensure business needs are met, and allow for regression testing
• Work closely with users to provide personalized software support as needed
• Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our backend infrastructure
• Document application support and operational procedures
• Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to foster their growth and development

The minimum we’re looking for (show us what you got if you aren’t a perfect fit):
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
• 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on building scalable and reliable systems
• Extensive knowledge of C#, LINQ, MS SQL, Entity Framework and related technologies
• Capable to use version control software such as GIT
• Knowledge of SOLID principles
• Knowledge of clean code practices
• Experience using web service protocols such as Rest, API design for extensibility and integration
• Experience debugging complex applications
• Experience with Agile development project management methodologies
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Experience with Azure or AWS is a plus

Why TransPerfect:

For 30 years, we have honed a culture where all kinds of ideas are shared and new ventures are not only welcomed, but also encouraged. In this fast-paced environment, employees are intellectually stimulated so they can grow alongside the organization. From Intern to President, we believe that every single employee should have a voice and contribute to the amazing services we offer our clients.

We also offer:
• A dynamic, well-functioning software development division with the world's largest provider of language services and technology solutions
• Significant room for growth and creative opportunities
• A healthy work-life balance, prioritized and encouraged by your team
• An overwhelming preference for promoting internally
• An opportunity to have real impact in product direction and development

Work model:

This position is intended to be largely in-office with a focus on flexibility. Today, most of the global team is on a hybrid model ranging between 3-4 days in the office per week. We aim to find an inclusive balance between everyone's personal lives and responsibilities and the value created from in-office collaboration. We work with new team members to find that balance with them while building the trust and collaboration that our team values.

We believe that sharing the same physical space with our colleagues creates a level of trust and understanding that fosters innovation and a sense of purpose.

The socializing and relationships formed from these in-person interactions have created the bonds that make our team successful.

We not only want to encourage people to safely spend time in the office, but also, schedule regular travel between our offices in Europe and the US – and a regular conference where the entire worldwide team is gathered together. Maybe the Metaverse will replace the office some day – but it hasn't yet! Online meetings were a powerful connector during the pandemic – but they don't foster the same connection.

By applying, I confirm I have read and accepted TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting
